items.dragHint: Tip: you can also drag app shortcuts, .exe files or web shortcuts into this window.
items.dragUnavailableAsAdmin: Dragging files into AutoStart is unavailable while it runs as administrator. Use "Add app" instead.

itemForm.name: Name
itemForm.workingDirHint: Optional. Defaults to the executable's folder.
itemForm.startMinimizedHint: The window opens minimized without taking focus from the simulator. Some apps may ignore it.
itemForm.waitForSimConnectHint: Opens after the other items, once the simulator accepts addon connections.
itemForm.waitForSimConnectUnsupported: Available only for MSFS 2020 and MSFS 2024.
itemForm.restartOnCrashHint: While the simulator is running, AutoStart reopens the app if it crashes (up to 3 times per session). Apps you close normally are not reopened.
itemForm.processNameAutoHint: AutoStart finds the real process on its own, even when the executable is just a launcher.
itemForm.processNameManualHint: Set manually. AutoStart will not change this name.
itemForm.duplicate: This app is already in this profile. You can still save it (e.g. with different arguments).

settings.title: Settings
settings.startWithWindowsHint: Opens AutoStart when you sign in to Windows, without administrator rights.
settings.startMinimizedHint: Shows only the tray icon, without opening the window.
settings.gracefulTimeoutHint: After this delay, apps that did not close are force closed.
settings.closeOnlyIfLaunchedByAppHint: Apps that were already open before the simulator stay open.
settings.checkUpdatesOnStartupHint: Looks for a new version every time AutoStart opens.
settings.closeDelayHint: After the simulator exits, AutoStart waits this long before closing the apps. If the simulator is reopened meanwhile (e.g. after a crash), nothing is closed. 0 closes right away.
settings.showNotificationsHint: Windows notifications for failures, crashed apps and the countdown before closing, even while AutoStart is in the tray.

trigger.title: Welcome to AutoStart
trigger.description: AutoStart watches your simulator process (the trigger). When it starts, your helper apps open in the order you choose; when it exits, they are closed.

simulator.title: Which simulator do you use?
simulator.description: We will set up the example profile with the right trigger. You can change it later.

items.title: Add your apps
items.description: On the main screen, use "Add app" to pick an installed or open app (or drag the app's shortcut into the window) or "Add URL" to open a website. Drag the cards to set the order and use the test buttons to check without opening the simulator.

startup.title: Make it automatic
startup.description: With AutoStart starting with Windows, just open the simulator. It stays quietly in the system tray.

updates.upToDate: You are already on the latest version
updates.installFailed: The update failed and was cancelled

appPicker.title: Add app
appPicker.description: Pick an app installed on this computer or one that is open right now.
appPicker.emptyOpen: No open app found. Open the app and try again, or use the Installed tab.
appPicker.browseHint: Can't find it? Choose the .exe manually.
